definition: customers: COUNT(customer.id) of Customers (subsidiary 2, stage LIKE 'CUSTOMER%', firstorderdate NOT NULL, category NOT IN (2 Garage Experts, 14 Vendor)) created in this cohort month (TO_CHAR(datecreated,'YYYY-MM')), grouped by customer.category; names from the customercategory table (3 = DIY, 4 = Contractor, 7 = CA Will Call). m1_net_revenue: NET revenue (product only; shipping/tax excluded via i.itemtype IS NOT NULL and tl.taxline='F'; CustCred/CustRfnd deducted; SUM(-tl.foreignamount); t.type IN CustInvc/CashSale/CustCred/CustRfnd; t.subsidiary=2; tl.mainline='F') from those customers' transactions dated in the cohort month (TO_CHAR(trandate,'YYYY-MM') = TO_CHAR(datecreated,'YYYY-MM')). customers_m1: COUNT(DISTINCT customer) with an M1 line. m13_net_revenue: same join, trandate >= TRUNC(datecreated) AND trandate < TRUNC(datecreated) + 90 (first 90 calendar days from the creation day; the basis used by cohorts_m13.sql); null until the window has closed (month_end + 90 days <= as-of). m13_net_revenue_v1_timestamp_basis: the same window written trandate >= datecreated (timestamp, drops same-day orders placed after the record's creation time); carried because the Aug 18 2026 build's M1-3/M1 multiples were on this basis. customers_m13: COUNT(DISTINCT customer) with a line in the 90-day window. Query: src/data/queries/customer_mix.sql, one cohort month per call.
